Team,

As we prep for the Q2 leadership readout next week I want to consolidate the pipeline into a single, actionable rollup and get short account-level handoffs for any deals we expect to surface to the execs. Please help with the two asks below by EOD Friday 6/25:

1) Consolidated forecast: attach your current open opportunities (owner, ACV, stage, expected close, confidence %). Use the attached qbr_account_template.xlsx — one row per deal. In particular, flag any deals with conditional dependencies (legal, SOC evidence, pricing approval).

2) Account handoff note (bullet format; 6–8 lines max): for each account we should show on the exec slide, include one-line value prop, top 3 risks, the single next step owner+ETA, and a confidence score (1–5). Example bullets are in the template.

Why: the exec deck will include a prioritized waterfall of 8–12 deals and a 1-slide account brief per top deal. We need a clean owners’ roster and a short narrative we can paste into the slides — avoid long paragraphs.

Attachments: qbr_account_template.xlsx (sheet: DEALS + SUMMARY)

Thanks — tagging Aditya and Vivek for any prioritization guidance; Marissa, please coordinate collector and validate fields for the rollup.

-Camila
